# My Simon Game

![Simon Picture](data:image/png;base64,)

### Game Description

Simon is a memory based game. A button will light up and make a noise and then you have to click the same button. Every round another light will be added to the sequence. If you click any button in the wrong order you will lose the game and have to restart. Once you finish round 20 you win.
You can find this game at this [link](https://colby522.github.io/simon-game/).

I used *JavaScript*, *HTML*, and *CSS* to build this game.

I used [freecodecamp](freecodecamp.org) to find my simon sounds.
